name: Brida
role: Matron of Wyrmwood Manor, Civic Leader, Council Member
title: The Matron
bio: Matron of Wyrmwood Manor, Kaelrath's primary estate. She manages household staff, civic volunteers, community kitchens, and emergency crisis logistics. The heart of Emberheart's public welfare system.
motivation: Ensure every citizen of Emberheart is fed, housed, and cared for. No one left behind.
speech_patterns: cuts through political nonsense with practical reality
